segments.name: Office
segments.description: Acquires, develops, owns and manages office real estate in premier Los Angeles and Honolulu submarkets, renting office space to diverse tenants.
segments.evidence: The services for our office segment include primarily the rental of office space and other tenant services, including parking and storage space rental.

segments.name: Multifamily
segments.description: Acquires, develops, owns and manages multifamily real estate, renting apartments and providing tenant services in premier submarkets.
segments.evidence: The services for our multifamily segment include primarily the rental of apartments and other tenant services, including parking and storage space rental.

revenueModel.text: The company earns rental income from office and multifamily tenants for leased space, plus tenant services such as parking and storage, and fees from managing consolidated joint venture properties.
revenueModel.evidence: We are entitled to: (i) distributions based on invested capital, (ii) additional distributions based on cash net operating income or invested capital, (iii) fees for property management and other services, (iv) reimbursement of certain acquisition-related expenses and certain other costs, and (v) a carried interest for certain JVs if the investors' distributions exceed a hurdle rate.
